owner: CEO / Master Agent + COO-1 Execution Architect
purpose: Add 500 specialist closers without creating low-intelligence workers or duplicate management layers.

intelligence_contract.rule: Every specialist has CEO-level judgment, ownership, money awareness, risk awareness, prioritization and blocker escalation. No narrow or passive worker roles are allowed.
intelligence_contract.anti_duplication: More capacity cannot create parallel duplicate work. Every specialist must attach to one canonical task, one owner, one output path and one proof condition.
intelligence_contract.no_public_url_purchase_rule: No domain or paid public URL is purchased before the product is functional. Until then only local demo, static preview, or explicit no-url blocker is allowed.

cohorts.name: Product workflow closers
cohorts.mission: Turn product rules and data models into usable workflows.
cohorts.proof: A sample item can move through the full workflow.

cohorts.name: Quality and design closers
cohorts.mission: Improve clarity, trust, mobile usability and release quality.
cohorts.proof: Every release has a pass, blocked or accepted-risk decision.

cohorts.name: Data verification closers
cohorts.mission: Verify public business records, source links, fit reasons and safe use notes.
cohorts.proof: Rows are review-ready before any outbound action is counted.

cohorts.name: Offer and delivery closers
cohorts.mission: Convert pilot scope into quote-ready, intake-ready and delivery-ready operating proof.
cohorts.proof: Pilot scope, intake, acceptance and handoff fields exist before delivery starts.

cohorts.name: Audit and enforcement closers
cohorts.mission: Run missing-proof checks and prevent false done status.
cohorts.proof: Missing proof creates a visible task or blocker.

cohorts.name: Build and preview closers
cohorts.mission: Prepare local and preview demos without purchasing domains before the product is ready.
cohorts.proof: Each active demo has local path, blocker, fallback, check and rollback note.

daily_required_outputs: one proof artifact or blocker update per active cohort
